Priya (sec-eng): Heads-up — ACME asked for a consolidated packet for tomorrow's security review: RBAC change history, audit-log exports (redacted), KMS envelope unwrap proofs, and vuln triage timelines. I can assemble the packet but need raw log snippets and a short statement about tenant separation and privsep.
Tom (infra): I can pull the RBAC change history and syslog segments. Which time window do we need? ACME wants the last 90 days + proof of config drift checks.
Priya (sec-eng): 90 days is perfect. Also they want evidence that service account role changes require 2 approvals (our policy) + a recent sample of the approval workflow for a real change.
Rebecca (customer-sRE): They specifically asked for: (1) user/service account role change audit trail, (2) KMS envelope unwrap events linked to tenant IDs, (3) SIEM ingest proof (we ship to Splunk), and (4) a vuln triage timeline for CVE-2025-xxxx.
Dan (platform): For KMS unwraps: we can export CloudHSM/HSM audit events and show envelope unwrap entries. Note: we need to redact PEM/key material and tenant identifiers where requested. We have an export script:
```bash
./tools/export_kms_audit.sh --since 2024-11-01 --until 2025-02-28 --format=jsonl --redact-pii > acme_kms_unwraps.jsonl
```
Tom (infra): I'll run the RBAC export and share a sampled file. Output will include actor, acted_on, prev_roles, new_roles, approval_ids. Example snippet: 
```json
{"ts":"2025-02-10T14:12:03Z","actor":"svc-deploy","acted_on":"alice","prev_roles":["viewer"],"new_roles":["deployer"],"approval_ids":["appr_987"]}
```
Priya (sec-eng): Good. For SIEM ingest proof, we should include the agent heartbeat + indexing record. Dan, can you pull the Splunk index metadata for the same window? We should obfuscate tenant ids but keep correlation_id intact.
Dan (platform): Yup. We have an ingestion manifest export command: `splunk-export --index=redwood-telemetry --since=... --grep='tenant:' --sample 1000` — I'll provide a manifest csv showing ingestion timestamps, source, and event counts.
Rebecca (customer-sRE): Also, ACME is worried about privsep between platform services and customer workloads. Can you include a short diagram (png) and a 2-paragraph explanation that our control plane maintains tenant isolation + no shared process boundaries for inference workloads?
Priya (sec-eng): I'll write the explanation. For the diagram, can someone from infra drop a diagram into the packet? It can be the same one we used for last quarter’s audit.
Tom (infra): I'll attach the diag. NOTE: We should also archive a short vulnerability triage timeline for CVE-2025-xxxx — who tracked that?
Dan (platform): That was triaged by infra + runtime. Timeline summary: detection 2025-01-15, internal mitigations (config rollouts) 2025-01-16, patch rollout 2025-01-18, external disclosure 2025-01-20. I will produce a one-page timeline with links to PRs and runbook entries.
Priya (sec-eng): Great. Two compliance asks that we must be explicit about: (A) KMS key custody — describe key ownership, envelope model, and escrow policy; (B) audit log chain — how we guarantee immutability (write-once S3 + checksum + SIEM ingest + retention policy). Keep it succinct.
security-bot: Checklist created: security.packet.acme.3344556677 (items: rbacs_export, kms_unwraps, siem_manifest, vuln_timeline, diagram, exec_summary). Assigned to: Priya/Tom/Dan. Deadline: 2025-03-05 09:00 UTC.
Rebecca (customer-sRE): Quick Q: For the KMS unwraps, ACME's compliance team may ask for a signed attestation from the HSM vendor (attestation statement or cert). Can we request a vendor-signed attestation or provide equivalent HSM audit logs?
Dan (platform): We can provide HSM audit logs + our HSM vendor's attestation doc (we have a current attestation on file). It won't be per-tenant-signed, but the logs include envelope key_id and unwrap timestamps.
Priya (sec-eng): Action items summary: Tom => RBAC export + diagram; Dan => KMS audit export + HSM attestation + SIEM manifest; I => executive summary + redaction checklist + packet assemble. Rebecca => I'll coordinate any follow-up ACME asks on call.
Tom (infra): Running the export now, will post sample in #eng-archives and link here when done.
Priya (sec-eng): Thanks all. If anyone hits PII redaction edge-cases, tag me and I'll advise redaction rules. Also include a brief note in the packet about log retention policy and where proofs live (s3://compliance-evidence/acme-3344556677/).
Rebecca (customer-sRE): Appreciated — ACME's security reviewer asked for the packet before the call; if we can get a draft by EOD PT that'd be ideal.
Priya (sec-eng): EOD PT noted. I'll compile a draft and post a private link for review.
Dan (platform): Uploaded KMS export (redacted sample) to the compliance bucket and shared link in DM to Priya.
Tom (infra): RBAC sample posted to #eng-archives — link DM'd to Priya.
Priya (sec-eng): Closing loop: I'll merge artifacts into a zip, run the redaction script, and hand off to Rebecca for the ACME call. Thanks team :thumbsup:
